mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising real interest rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (<-1.5% median) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a fall in housing starts (HOUST) below 500k units signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 500k for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (<-0.8% median) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% on a year-over-year basis signals a dual tightening of monetary and inflationary pressures, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and rate hike regime
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (<-1.0% median) in at least 65% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above 5% YoY coincident with a decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals a shift from spending to saving, which reduces aggregate demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 5% YoY AND GDPC1 < 0% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) increase below 50k persons for three consecutive months signals weak labor market expansion, which constrains corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (<-0.6% median) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 400k units for four consecutive months signals a deepening housing market contraction, which reduces construction-related economic activity and drags on equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered episodes.
